decision.instructions:
FILE (only one): src/content/worlds/a12-benteng-keamanan/index.ts. Do not edit any other file. Keep every id, answer key, icon and step order. Each fix below names the current text exactly and gives the new text. Where t(junior, pro) has two arguments, change only the argument named.

A. FACT FIXES (Pro)
A1. a12-anc-p4, choice 'offline' explainWrong:

A2. a12-l03-q4, choice 'stop' explainWrong:
 old: 'POST tetap membawa cookie sesi kalau situs tujuan sama. Perlindungannya datang dari token CSRF dan SameSite.'

A3. a12-l01-q5, choice 'color' explainWrong:

decision.rationale:
Verdicts for a12, following the decision guide (correctness > hard rules > copydeck/§15-17 > persona taste). Counts: accepted 11, adapted 6 (the accepted field holds 17 = accepted + adapted), rejected 3, deferred 0.

# | source | issue | verdict | reason
1 | sari-27 | anc-p4 confuses HttpOnly with Secure | Adapt | The fact error is real. The new text names Set-Cookie and also separates HttpOnly from Secure.
2 | naya-8 | l01 concept code block, '<', 'Escaping', q2 | Reject | LessonPlayerPage.tsx:210 already shows concept code blocks only in Pro. One short snippet explained in the same sentence and an rTerm with its meaning are both allowed by copydeck §3.4 and §3.2 rule 3.
3 | naya-8 | l02 concept textContent and code block | Reject | The code block is already hidden from Junior. 'textContent' has 11 characters and is explained in its own sentence, which §3.4 allows. It also links to the optional Junior code challenge (spotbug q2).
4 | wulan-38 | l02-q3j giveaway and wrong idea of XSS | Accept | Correctness: it taught that bossy words are the danger. Rebuilt around checked versus unchecked and read versus acting. Ids and answer map are kept.
5 | naya-8 | 'berjalan' read as walking | Accept | Junior now uses one verb throughout ('bekerja'), in 9 items. Junior sentences stay at 12 words or fewer.
6 | sari-27 | l03-q4 'kalau situs tujuan sama' | Adapt | Accurate now: with default SameSite=Lax, the cross-site cookie depends on SameSite, so the text says 'Tanpa SameSite'.
7 | wulan-38 | l04 limit same/different not comparing | Accept | The new points compare with the analogy. The card is Pro-only (riskyAnalogy false), and the .env facts are still in the concept card.
8 | naya-8 | 'backend' in junior l01 concept | Reject | Copydeck §3.2 rule 7: backend is introduced in a01 and has a Junior glossary entry.
9 | sari-27 | l01-q5 mixed content outdated | Adapt | Accurate: scripts are blocked and images are upgraded to HTTPS. The suggested text did not mention images.
10 | dimas-14 | l03-q3 no why, outdated | Accept | Adds window.opener and tabnabbing with a meaning, and the note about browser defaults.
11 | raka-11 | l02-q2j giveaway | Accept | Wrong options now tempt. Lengths stay within 3 words.
12 | raka-11 | j4, l04-r1, l01-q6 giveaways | Adapt | j4 now uses a real enumeration leak and r1 a tempting distractor. For the TF, a 'false' rewrite would flip the answer, so the answer stays true and the statement is less obvious.
13 | wulan-38 | junior phishing: involve an adult | Accept | Child-safety behavior, and it removes 'halaman login' from the Junior story.
14 | sari-27 | Pro choice length, 2FA undefined | Adapt | Shortened anc-p1 and removed '2FA' from l04-q5. The l02-q4 part is a false positive because the correct answer is not the longest.
15 | dimas-14 | l03 XSS sim off-topic | Adapt | Kept the sim so the card rhythm (§6.7) still holds, and reworded it as an XSS-versus-CSRF contrast.
16 | sari-27 | CSRF token 'sekali pakai' | Accept | Most frameworks use per-session tokens. Fixed in the concept and in q2 r4.
17 | sari-27 | l03 story analogy not set up | Accept | Added a bridge sentence of 20 words or fewer.
18 | dimas-14 | l02-q7 explainCorrect | Accept | Explains why: the attacker controls location.hash through the link.
19 | wulan-38 | 5-second timer in companion | Accept | No clocks in Junior (decision guide §3).

Every change stays in the one owned file. done: true is fine once the executor applies the edits and the validator passes. One copydeck gap is out of scope (the second 'different' point on the l02 limit card shows in Junior) and is in the instructions for the orchestrator.

judgeIssues.problem: Factual error: "HttpOnly justru diatur oleh server dan dikirim lewat HTTPS." HttpOnly only blocks JavaScript access. Sending only over HTTPS is the Secure flag. The lesson itself separates the two, so this teaches a contradiction.
judgeIssues.suggestion: "Cookie HttpOnly justru diatur oleh server lewat header Set-Cookie. Server-lah yang memasangnya, bukan cookie yang berjalan sendiri."

judgeIssues.where: a12-l01 conceptStep 'Periksa di Dua Tempat' (code block + body) and a12-l01-q2
judgeIssues.problem: Code is left in junior. The `code` field ('Masukan: <script>\nEscaped: <script>') has no mode gate, rCode('<') shows to junior, and the junior term is rTerm('sanitasi','Escaping','Escaping'). The junior quiz then asks "Apa tugas escaping pada tulisan dari tamu?" Naya does not know the word 'escaping' and cannot read <.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Gate the code block and rCode('<') to pro. Use 'Penyaring' or 'mengubah tanda aneh' as the junior term label, and reword the q2 junior prompt to "Apa gunanya mengubah tanda aneh di tulisan tamu?"

judgeIssues.problem: Code is left in junior. The text says "Pembuat situs memakai " + rCode('textContent', ['junior']), and the code block '// BERBAHAYA:\nkotak.innerHTML = komentar;' has no mode gate, so junior sees JavaScript.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Remove rCode('textContent',['junior']) and the junior sentence that goes with it, and make the code block pro-only. For junior, keep only "Tampilkan komentar tamu sebagai tulisan biasa, bukan perintah."

judgeIssues.problem: Giveaway and wrong idea. The labels start with 'Pengumuman:' / 'Pertanyaan:' / 'Perintah:', and the bin is called 'Perintah jahat', so the prefix gives the answer. It also teaches that bossy words are the danger. In XSS, a comment like "kirim kata sandi ke aku" shown as plain text is harmless. The danger is text that the page runs. This goes against the lesson's own rule to show it as plain text.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Remove the prefixes. Sort 'hanya dibaca' vs 'bisa membuat halaman bertindak sendiri', or rebuild the task around Pak Udin checking papers before he pins them, without judging what the words mean.

judgeIssues.where: a12-anc-j2, a12-anc-j5, a12-l02 concept, a12-l02-q4, a12-l02-r1/r2 (junior)
judgeIssues.problem: 'Berjalan' is used for code running: "Tulisan itu bisa berjalan seperti perintah", "Kertas di web bisa berjalan", "Tulisan biasa ... tidak ikut berjalan". An 8-year-old reads 'berjalan' as walking, so the key idea gets lost.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Use one concrete verb all through junior, e.g. "bisa menyuruh halaman melakukan sesuatu" / "ikut bekerja seperti perintah", and keep it the same in every item.

judgeIssues.problem: Misleading statement: "POST tetap membawa cookie sesi kalau situs tujuan sama." Cross-site POSTs also carry cookies unless SameSite stops them. That is exactly why POST alone does not stop CSRF. The phrase 'kalau situs tujuan sama' confuses this.
judgeIssues.suggestion: "POST tetap membawa cookie sesi, bahkan dari situs jebakan lewat form tersembunyi. Karena itu POST perlu ditemani token CSRF dan SameSite."

judgeIssues.where: a12-l04 limitStep ('Kunci rumah di ruang tamu terbuka')
judgeIssues.problem: The same/different slots do not compare anything with the analogy. same: "Menyembunyikan tombol dengan CSS tidak benar-benar menyembunyikan isinya". different: "File .env aman dipakai untuk rahasia backend..." and "Pastikan juga file itu tidak diunggah ke Git." These are separate facts, not ways the analogy holds or breaks, which raises cognitive load.
judgeIssues.suggestion: same: "Barang di ruang tamu bisa dilihat semua tamu, begitu juga kode frontend." different: "Di rumah, kamu bisa mengunci laci. Di browser, tidak ada laci: semua kode frontend terkirim utuh ke pengunjung."

judgeIssues.problem: Junior text ends with "pengaman utama ada di ruang dalam, yaitu " + rTerm('backend','backend','backend'), which shows the English jargon 'backend' to an 8-year-old with no explanation.
judgeIssues.suggestion: End the junior text with "ruang dalam." and make rTerm backend pro-only (rPro / modes ['pro']).

judgeIssues.problem: Factually outdated: "Browser sering tetap memuat file HTTP, tetapi menandainya tidak aman." Modern browsers block HTTP scripts (active mixed content) on HTTPS pages and upgrade images on their own. The story is about images and scripts.
judgeIssues.suggestion: "Browser modern justru memblokir skrip HTTP di halaman HTTPS dan menandai halaman tidak aman. Masalah utamanya tetap jalur tanpa enkripsi."

judgeIssues.problem: Does not explain WHY and is partly outdated: "Halaman tujuan bisa mengambil kendali tab asal." It does not say how (window.opener / tabnabbing). Modern browsers also apply noopener by default to target=_blank, so Dimas may feel lectured with old information.
judgeIssues.suggestion: "Tanpa noopener, halaman tujuan bisa memakai window.opener untuk mengganti tab asal ke situs tiruan (tabnabbing). Browser baru sudah memasangnya otomatis, tetapi menulisnya tetap aman untuk browser lama."

judgeIssues.problem: Giveaway: the story says "Pak Udin menjaganya", the prompt asks "Apa tugas Pak Udin?", and the choices are 'Memeriksa setiap kertas dulu' vs 'Menempel kertas tanpa memeriksa' vs 'Mencopot papan dari kelas'. Raka gets it right without thinking and does not feel smart.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Make the wrong options plausible, e.g. 'Merapikan kertas agar lurus' or 'Menempel kertas yang paling berwarna di depan', so the child has to recall why kertas is checked.

judgeIssues.problem: Giveaway choices: "Kata sandi yang benar adalah 123456", "Di kertas di bawah keset", and the TF "Tulisan dari tamu harus diperiksa dulu." are obviously silly or obviously true, so they test nothing.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Replace them with wrong options that tempt, e.g. j4: '"Email ini belum terdaftar"'; l04-r1: 'Di catatan kecil di pojok halaman'; and rewrite the TF as a false statement a child might believe ('Tulisan tamu yang pendek pasti aman').

judgeIssues.problem: The junior text tells children to judge login pages and type passwords on their own: "Periksa alamat situs sebelum mengisi kata sandi", answer "Tidak mengisi kata sandi, periksa alamat resmi". For age 8 the safe behavior is to ask an adult. 'Halaman login' is also jargon for Naya.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Junior answer: "Jangan isi apa pun, tunjukkan ke orang tua atau guru". Text: "Kalau ada halaman yang meminta kata sandi, panggil orang dewasa dulu."

judgeIssues.problem: Choices differ in length, so the correct one stands out: "Karena orang bisa melewati validasi lewat DevTools atau request langsung ke API" and "Jangan masukkan kata sandi, periksa alamat resmi, aktifkan 2FA" are much longer and more specific than the wrong ones. '2FA' is also never defined; the concept says 'verifikasi 2 langkah'.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Make the choices about the same length (shorten the correct one, e.g. 'Validasi frontend bisa dilewati lewat DevTools'), and use 'verifikasi 2 langkah' in place of '2FA'.

judgeIssues.problem: Off-topic sim inside the CSRF/clickjacking lesson: "Di Benteng Uji, lihat bagaimana celah XSS membuat skrip bisa membaca token di halaman." This feels like filler and breaks the lesson's flow.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Remove this sim from l03, or frame it as a contrast: "Bandingkan: XSS mencuri dari dalam halaman, CSRF menumpang cookie dari luar."

judgeIssues.where: a12-l03 conceptStep 'CSRF: Permintaan Palsu Lintas Situs' and a12-l03-q2 r4
judgeIssues.problem: "CSRF token sekali pakai di setiap form" overstates the requirement. Most frameworks use per-session tokens, so a career-switcher will be confused at work.
judgeIssues.suggestion: "CSRF token acak yang dicek server di setiap form" (drop 'sekali pakai').

judgeIssues.problem: The analogy appears before it is set up: "Resepsionis yang melihat gelang aksesmu akan memprosesnya". The gelang akses / resepsionis has not been introduced, so on a phone during a commute the sentence is confusing.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Add one bridge sentence: "Cookie sesi itu seperti gelang akses gedung: resepsionis memproses permintaan siapa pun yang memakainya."

judgeIssues.problem: "Mengganti innerHTML dengan textContent menutup celah DOM-based XSS." The template never showed innerHTML, and it does not explain WHY location.hash is dangerous (an attacker controls it through the link).
judgeIssues.suggestion: "location.hash dikendalikan siapa pun yang membuat tautan. textContent menampilkannya sebagai teks, jadi tag di dalamnya tidak dijalankan (DOM-based XSS tertutup)."

judgeIssues.problem: "minta menebak mana yang asli dalam 5 detik" adds time pressure. Spotting a fake URL should be a slow, careful habit, not a fast game.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Remove the 5-second limit: "...lalu cari bersama huruf mana yang berbeda."

judgeIssues.problem: Code and jargon reach junior through side text: "2 bertanda \"<script>\"", "kunci pembayaran", "Kata sandi gudang data". Naya cannot picture what these are.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Junior cards: '2 kartu bertanda gambar petir (tulisan nakal)'. Replace 'kunci pembayaran' with 'kode rahasia untuk membayar' and 'gudang data' with 'kata sandi lemari data toko'.

implementation.result: Applied to the world bundle and validated with zero a12 findings. All question IDs and answer keys are retained.
adaptations: The POST feedback now describes checking intent and the CSRF token without assuming a universal browser cookie default.
The new-tab prompt distinguishes explicit protection for older browsers from the implicit behavior of current browsers.
The mixed-content, text rendering and simulation feedback use defensive language. Junior exercises use plain, short Indonesian and an adult companion.
